_about: Gore Vidal (1925-2012), American novelist, for the Word Hoard. Added 2026-11-15 by the non-renewal sweep, batch 5 (Adam 2026-11-03: "I want everything that was not renewed"). Messiah (1954) and Williwaw (1946) are US public domain: neither was renewed, while his other books of 1948-1960 (including the Edgar Box mysteries) all show their renewals (see _waiting). No uids minted.

vidal-messiah: Messiah (New York: E. P. Dutton, copyright 1954)
vidal-williwaw: Williwaw: A Novel (New York: E. P. Dutton, 1946)

_nonrenewal.vidal-messiah: Non-renewal sweep batch 5, 2026-11-15. New York: E. P. Dutton & Co., 1954 (Gutenberg's 'Original publication' line). Vidal was American and the book was first published in the US, so URAA does not reach it. Renewal search: pipeline/renewal_check.py over NYPL's cce-renewals (renewal was due 1981-82), author plus title words, --title-only 'Messiah', and --surname vidal: no renewal of this book, while The City and the Pillar (R632460), The Season of Comfort (R651065), A Search for the King (RE5624), Dark Green, Bright Red (RE5623), the three Edgar Box mysteries of 1952-54 (RE50523, RE87570, RE132418) and Visit to a Small Planet (RE222291) all show theirs. US public domain by non-renewal; Project Gutenberg released it on the same reading. The revised edition of 1965 is a different, later text and is not this one.
_nonrenewal.vidal-williwaw: Non-renewal sweep batch 6, 2026-11-15. New York: E. P. Dutton, 1946 (Gutenberg's 'Original publication' line), Vidal's first novel. American author, US first edition. Renewal search (due 1973-74): none for the 1946 book. The one renewal naming it, RE492396 (1990), renews the 1962 omnibus registration A579337 (Williwaw, A Thirsty Evil and Julian the Apostate), which covers only new matter of 1962. US public domain by non-renewal.

_waiting.vidal-city-and-the-pillar: The City and the Pillar (1948): A20219, renewed R632460.
_waiting.vidal-search-for-the-king: A Search for the King (1950): renewed RE5624.
_waiting.vidal-edgar-box: Death in the Fifth Position (1952), Death before Bedtime (1953), Death Likes It Hot (1954), as Edgar Box: renewed RE50523, RE87570, RE132418.
